# Getting Started

#### Read how to get started with the Doxis AI.dp platform.

Are you new to the Doxis AI.dp Platform? This section provides you with all the information you need to get started. It will guide you through some essential features of Doxis AI.dp including configuring **access control**, **enabling services**, and finding your **api keys**.

The Doxis AI.dp Platform consists of:

- Organizations: This can be your company account.
- Projects: They are your different use cases.
- Services: They are the different functionalities for each project.

To learn more about how organizations and projects work, refer to the [Organizations and Projects documentation](https://dochorizon.klippa.com/docs/platform/organizations-and-projects). For step-by-step instructions, refer to the [Organization Creation](https://dochorizon.klippa.com/docs/platform/organizations-and-projects/organization-creation) and [Project Creation](https://dochorizon.klippa.com/docs/platform/organizations-and-projects/project-creation) pages.

The following video introduces the Doxis AI.dp Platform, how to navigate it and set up your account.

### Library

[![document](https://dochorizon.klippa.com/docs/static/doctoolkit-P0QTDQuv.png)\\
\\
New to Doxis AI.dp? The Library offers ready-made templates for the most common document types. Pick a template and Doxis AI.dp sets up all the services, configurations, and flows for you automatically, so you can start processing documents with almost no manual setup.](https://dochorizon.klippa.com/docs/platform/document-library)

### Settings

The Settings menu is organized into three sections: **Organization**, **Project**, and **Account**. Use the toggle at the top of the Settings menu to switch between organization-level and project-level settings. Account settings apply to your personal account and are always accessible regardless of which project or organization you are in.

### Access Control

[![person](https://dochorizon.klippa.com/docs/static/user-1-DEk2iLq8.png)\\
\\
Navigate to the User Management section to manage access to your organization or project. To access User Management, go to Settings, select the Organization or Project section, then go to Access control and select Users. This page provides a form to invite new users and shows the current access levels. You can invite users by entering their email addresses and assigning appropriate roles.\\
\\
_**Example Use Case:**_ Ensure your team members have the necessary access levels to work effectively on projects by managing their permissions in this section.](https://dochorizon.klippa.com/docs/platform/access-control)

### Enabling Services

![settings](https://dochorizon.klippa.com/docs/static/settings-CcbcdCvu.png)

For each project, you have the flexibility to enable only the necessary services. You can do this by using the toggle buttons on either the **Services Page** or the **Project Home Page**. When enabled, these services will be active for users assigned to the project. To learn more about a specific service, click on the corresponding service link to navigate to its dedicated page, which includes detailed documentation and, if applicable, links to a demo environment. This allows you to have precise control over which users have access to each service.

_**Important Note:**_ The status of a toggle button (on or off) indicates whether the service is currently active for your project.

### API Keys

[![auth](https://dochorizon.klippa.com/docs/static/authentication-LXujOu5m.png)\\
\\
In each project, there is a main API key that you can use. Additionally, you have the ability to create new API keys and groups of API keys (credentials). Similar to project-wide service management, you can enable or disable services for API keys. Your API keys can be found on the **credentials** page. The name for your main api key is `default`. By using the toggle at the top, you can enable all services for this API key.\\
\\
_**Usage Example:**_ Use the main API key in authentication headers to access the API and manage the corresponding services effectively.](https://dochorizon.klippa.com/docs/platform/credentials)

### Billing

[![billing](https://dochorizon.klippa.com/docs/static/billingIcon-BSYZO9lx.png)\\
\\
Accessing services on the Doxis AI.dp platform requires a billing account. When you create a Doxis AI.dp account, you will receive an initial billing account that comes with **a free 25 euro credit** to help you get started. The billing account operates on a prepaid plan. To continue using Doxis AI.dp services after the free credits have run out, you need to complete your billing account setup. Follow the prompts on the billing page to enter your payment information and activate your account.\\
\\
_**Next Steps:**_ Once your billing account is set up, you can proceed to enable services for your projects.](https://dochorizon.klippa.com/docs/platform/billing)
